strings.policy.global-baseline.title: Global privacy baseline
strings.policy.global-baseline.summary: Rianell stores health logs on your device by default. Cloud backup, anonymised research contribution, and on-device AI are optional and require separate consent. You can Exporteren or Verwijderen your data at any time.
strings.policy.eu-gdpr.title: EEA & UK - GDPR
strings.policy.eu-gdpr.summary: Health data is special-category data under GDPR Art. 9. We rely on your explicit consent to process it locally and for optional cloud, research, and AI features. You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection.
strings.policy.data-subject-rights.title: Your data rights
strings.policy.data-subject-rights.summary: You may Downloaden a Kopiëren of your health logs, request correction, withdraw consent, or Verwijderen local and cloud data from Instellingen. Contact the operator for formal data-subject requests.
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-us-ca.title: California (CCPA/CPRA)
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-us-ca.summary: We do not sell personal information. California residents have rights to know, Verwijderen, and correct personal information. Health logs are consumer wellness data, not HIPAA-covered provider records unless you use Rianell under a healthcare BAA.
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-us.title: United States - other states
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-us.summary: Consumer wellness self-tracking is generally outside HIPAA unless you are a covered entity or business associate. State privacy laws may grant access and deletion rights similar to our global baseline.
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-au.title: Australia
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-au.summary: Australian Privacy Principles apply to personal information we hold. You may access and correct your data and complain to the OAIC.
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-br.title: Brazil (LGPD)
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-br.summary: LGPD grants confirmation, access, correction, anonymisation, portability, deletion, and information about sharing. Health data may receive heightened protection.

strings.tutorial.slide0.body: Do you want to use AI Analysis (patterns, insights, summary) and Goals & targets? You can turn this on later in Instellingen.
strings.tutorial.slide1.body: Track your health daily: log Symptomen, food, exercise, Pijn areas, and more in one place.
strings.tutorial.slide2.body: View Logs shows your history. AI Analysis finds patterns and correlations across your data.
strings.tutorial.slide3.body: In Instellingen, you can create an account to Opslaan your data encrypted in the cloud and Delen between devices.
strings.tutorial.slide3.openData: Use open data for training AI - when on, AI uses open shared data; when off, AI uses only your personal data. Used for personalised AI analysis and advice.
strings.tutorial.slide3.accountBody: Create an account to Opslaan your data encrypted in the cloud and sync between devices.
strings.tutorial.slide4.anonHint: Delen your anonymised data to help improve AI models
strings.tutorial.slide4.openDataHint: Use anonymised data pool for AI training (requires 90+ days of data). Used for personalised AI analysis and advice.
strings.tutorial.slide5.body: Toegankelijkheid options help you make the app easier to read and use from day one. You can change these anytime later in Instellingen → Toegankelijkheid.
strings.tutorial.slide5.largeTextHint: Quick preset for bigger text across the app.
strings.tutorial.slide5.ttsHint: Tap buttons/controls to hear their label read aloud.
strings.tutorial.slide5.readModeHint: Also reads when a control gets focus (keyboard and assistive navigation).
strings.tutorial.slide6.body: Set Goals & targets with the target button next to Instellingen. Choose daily targets for steps, hydration, Slaap score, and good days per week.
strings.tutorial.slide6.progress: Your progress and "Last 7 days vs targets" appear on the Home tab so you can see how you're doing.
strings.tutorial.slide7.body: You're all set. Sluiten to start logging, try Demo Mode, or create an account to Opslaan your data in the cloud.
strings.common.consent.healthDataBody: Rianell slaat symptoom- en welzijnslogs op uw apparaat op. Dit zijn bijzondere gezondheidsgegevens onder de AVG. Door verder te gaan geeft u uitdrukkelijke toestemming (art. 9(2)(a)) voor lokale verwerking om de app te laten werken. Cloudback-up, anonieme bijdrage en on-device AI vereisen aparte schakelaars.
strings.common.consent.healthDataContact: Contact: jan.andersson@rianell.com. Zie ons privacybeleid voor uw rechten.
